title: ledger_entry
key_points: The ledger_entry method retrieves a specific ledger entry from the XRP Ledger.
It takes the hash of the transaction or the index of the entry as input.
The method returns detailed information about the specified ledger entry.
limitations: Requires knowledge of the XRP Ledger's internal mechanisms and data structures.
asserts: The ledger_entry public API method allows retrieving detailed information about a specific transaction or ledger entry in the XRP Ledger.
scope: Describes the functionality and usage of the ledger_entry method within the context of the XRP Ledger's public API.
